iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (XK for Kosovo). The key that joins every module.

phone.description: Numbering plans for this row. Most rows have one; some have several (Palestine: +970 and +972).

leading_digits.description: Regex the national number must start with when the calling code is shared (e.g. +1 809|829|849 for DO). null when the code is not shared this way.

primary.description: true when this row is the default country for the calling code.

trunk_prefix.description: Digit(s) dropped from local numbers before the calling code (0 in 0501234567).

pattern.description: Regex for any valid national number (all types). Match against the full national number.

lengths.description: Valid national number lengths, all types.

mobile_pattern.description: Regex for a valid mobile national number. Match against the full national number.

mobile_prefixes.description: Leading digits of mobile numbers (up to 3 digits). Quick check; use mobile_pattern for exact validation.

mobile_distinguishable.description: false when mobile and landline numbers look the same (US, CA).

mobile_example.description: Example mobile national number, good as an input placeholder.

mobile_format.description: Display grouping for a mobile national number, # = digit.
